caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular stone relief set within a decorative frame featuring gothic-style arches and trimming. Inside the relief, there is a figure of a man with a crown of thorns, his arms outstretched and raised, nailed to the vertical surface by both hands. His head is tilted downward toward his right shoulder. He is wearing a loincloth draped around his waist and falls to mid-thigh. Above the man's head is a small tablet with the inscription "INRI." The entire relief is rendered in muted brown, beige, and gray tones, suggesting the appearance of aged stone. The drawing is centered on a blank, off-white background with ample space surrounding the rectangular frame. There is no additional detail outside the frame besides a small, subtle inscription of the artist's name, "Stanley Shaw," at the lower right.
title: Bas Relief Plaque
